overall: The complaint was timely. The Commission may not rely on the Open Meeting Law to redact the April 2023 executive session video, because the session was improperly held. The redaction question goes to the Public Records Law, so the parties were referred to the Supervisor of Records. The Commission must review the executive-session training video and checklist.
